summary: A late-night closing rule is widened after officials credit it, while owners cut workers' hours.
realLife: A city council ordered some corner stores, take-out shops and food trucks in one neighborhood to close overnight to curb violent crime. After a sponsor credited it with a large drop in killings, the council twice widened the area, the mayor let the second widening become law unsigned, and a coalition of business groups asked for a recall. A food truck owner said late sales were essential, that he lost customers after the first widening and cut his workers' hours.
sources: CBS News Philadelphia (Philadelphia, Pennsylvania), 'Philadelphia's overnight business curfew expands again, covering more North Philly neighborhoods', September 11, 2025: https://www.cbsnews.com/amp/philadelphia/news/kensington-curfew-philadelphia-food-trucks
